sentences.text:
(Presently Lodged In District Jail, Pratapgarh)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Hemank Vaishnav For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shrawan Kumar, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/08/2023

This application for bail has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. in connection with FIR No.41/2023 Police Station Deogarh, District Pratapgarh, for the offences under Sections 376 and 120-B of IPC.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been implicated in the present case on the basis of the statements of co-accused-Shankar S/o Lalu Ram who has already been enlarged on bail by a co-ordiante Bench of this Court vide order dated 18.08.2023 (S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9808/2023).

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9808/2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that challan against the present petitioner has already been filed; the petitioner is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
[CRLMB-9425/2023] Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.
However, he was not in position to dispute that aforementioned co-accused has already been enlarged on bail.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that co-accused-Shankar has already been enlarged on bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court and Anil Kumar vs State Of Rajasthan on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178318072/

sentences.text: 1 looking to the possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that petitioner-Anil Kumar S/o Gorakh Nath, arrested in connection with FIR No.41/2023 Police Station Deogarh, District Pratapgarh; provided he executes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
Petitioner shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 102-KshamaD/-
